chief_complaint: Chronic kidney disease with proteinuria and hypertension, complicated by ischemic heart disease and metabolic syndrome.
history_of_present_illness: The patient has a long-standing history of progressive renal disease, documented as chronic kidney disease stage 1 in 1980, advancing to stage 3 by 1983, with concurrent proteinuria and microalbuminuria attributed to type 2 diabetes mellitus. Hypertension was diagnosed in 1978 and has been treated with lisinopril. Ischemic heart disease was identified in 1979, and metabolic syndrome with obesity has been present since the early 1960s. Anemia has been noted since 1973. Despite a recorded finding of prediabetes, the patient is on mixed‑dose insulin, indicating overt diabetes. He reports chronic pain managed with acetaminophen/hydrocodone and receives oral iron for anemia. Social factors include full‑time employment, unsatisfactory housing, and a history of military service. The last documented encounter was in 1984, and many recent laboratory and vital sign data are missing.
